risks.risk: Exact PS4 model/condition (CUH revision) and whether it’s a PS4 vs PS4 Pro/other variant.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the console label showing CUH model number (e.g., CUH-10xx/11xx/20xx) and serial.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used PS4 with unknown revision and unknown condition.

risks.risk: Whether the controllers are original and fully functional (buttons, sticks, triggers, charging).
risks.proof: Video clip showing both controllers connected and working in-game (camera/motion not required), plus a close-up of controller model/label.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if controllers may be non-original or not fully guaranteed.

risks.risk: Installed games count (claim of 5) and whether they are playable (account/license issues).
risks.proof: Photo/screenshot of the PS4 home screen showing the installed games list (or a video scrolling installed games).
risks.if_unproven: Price as if games are not included/unknown value.

risks.risk: Port functionality (HDMI, USB, power) and general hardware health (disc drive if present).
risks.proof: Video clip testing: HDMI output to TV, at least one USB device, and (if applicable) disc drive test with a disc.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested/assume worst-case for ports (i.e., not guaranteed).

risks.proof: Short gameplay or system stress test video showing stable operation and fan behavior (no shutdowns).
risks.if_unproven: Price as if overheating risk exists (worst-case used unit).

risks.risk: Receipt/origin claim (UK receipt) and authenticity of accessories.
risks.proof: Photo of the receipt and any matching serial/model numbers on the console label.
risks.if_unproven: Price without any added value for receipt/origin.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the PS4 console label showing CUH model number and serial (photo).
Video showing the PS4 turning on, reaching the home screen, and showing the installed games list (confirm 5).
Video testing ports: HDMI display works and at least one USB device works (and disc drive test if it has one).
Video testing both controllers (buttons/sticks/triggers) and close-up of controller labels to confirm originality.
Photo of the UK receipt (and ensure it matches the console serial/model).
response.reason: The photo confirms a PS4 console with controllers, but key pricing drivers (exact PS4 variant, controller originality/function, installed games count, and port/overheating status) are not verifiable from the single image. Request the most decisive proof before pricing.
